typography: Keep heading scale proportional to content and viewport.
Keep body line length readable and hierarchy explicit.
Keep typography and spacing stable when user text size increases.
spacing: Use a consistent spacing rhythm across sections and components.
Avoid both accidental dead space and cramped content.
Align navigation, cards, headings, and supporting copy to intentional grids.
composition: Hero composition must communicate priority without consuming unnecessary viewport height.
Avoid repetitive card grids when grouping or editorial composition communicates better.
Technical diagrams must remain legible at target viewport widths.
brand: Preserve official ILAIOS logo geometry and brand colors.
Use accents selectively; gradients and glows require a compositional reason.
Do not introduce unapproved visual identity systems.
motion: Motion must communicate state, causality, continuity, or hierarchy.
Prefer restrained transform/opacity transitions over layout-shifting animation.
User-driven motion must remain interruptible and retarget from the currently presented state.
Gesture release must not introduce an avoidable momentum discontinuity.
Reversible transitions must preserve spatial source and path consistency.
interaction: Interactive elements need visible hover, focus, and pressed feedback where applicable.
Input feedback should begin with the interaction and remain continuous while direct manipulation is active.
Gesture-driven content must track pointer or touch movement without artificial discontinuity.
Visual affordance must match actual clickability.
Touch targets must remain usable on mobile.
responsive: No horizontal page scrolling at required viewports.
No clipping, overlap, unreadable wrapping, or orphaned controls.
Mobile composition must be designed, not merely stacked from desktop.
accessibility: Text and controls must retain readable contrast.
Menu state and focus return must be operable without a pointer.
Translucent surfaces need a legible reduced-transparency fallback when applicable.
Interfaces need a higher-contrast fallback where the platform requests increased contrast.
antiGenericAI: Flag arbitrary purple/blue-style glow or gradient decoration not grounded in ILAIOS brand.
Flag card-inside-card repetition and universal pill styling.
Flag decorative icon tiles with no semantic purpose.
Flag repetitive equal-weight CTAs and weak action hierarchy.
Flag gratuitous scroll-reveal animation and ornamental motion.
